environment.description: Single EC2 instance (m5.large) running the Node.js monolith directly via pm2 in cluster mode (4 workers sharing memory via IPC). Instance is behind a classic ELB with no additional middleware. Security group allows inbound 80/443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No rate limiting configured. Response headers are default Express headers with no CSP or security headers added. The race condition in /api/withdraw is exploitable by sending concurrent requests that pass the balance check before any deduction occurs across the clustered workers.
